crop_review_note: Zero inset. The northern and southern engraved frame strokes are traced through the central fold at eight-pixel intervals. Across the pale gap between southern hatch blocks, the curve interpolates between their engraved ends. The southeast corner is the intersection of the vertical rule with the horizontal map-side edge. The final dark stripe on the vertical band ends above that intersection.
